svg.title: Mean course of daily GPP, Reco and NEE from 14 days before to 14 days after the recorded date, per episode kind and over all sites, in percent of the mean of the 7 days before the episode (NEE in percent of the GPP before).
svg.desc: Three panels: GPP, Reco and NEE. X axis: day relative to the recorded date (-14 to +14, local days). Y axis: percent of the before mean (GPP and Reco: 100 % = no change; NEE: percent of the GPP before, 0 = neutral, NEE < 0 = uptake). A day is drawn when 2 or more episodes have a value; the band is the 25 to 75 % range when 5 or more episodes have a value. Episodes need a GPP before of 1 g C m-2 d-1 or more. Harvest or cut (n = 32): mean of days +1 to +7: GPP 57 %, Reco 115 %, NEE 21 % of the GPP before. Grazing (n = 5): mean of days +1 to +7: GPP 86 %, Reco 109 %, NEE −5 % of the GPP before. Tillage (n = 6): mean of days +1 to +7: GPP 39 %, Reco 93 %, NEE 163 % of the GPP before. Sowing (n = 3): mean of days +1 to +7: GPP 117 %, Reco 108 %, NEE 7 % of the GPP before. Fertilisation (n = 13): mean of days +1 to +7: GPP 163 %, Reco 159 %, NEE −31 % of the GPP before.
